evals.prompt: Use code-review to review the committed changes since HEAD~1. Work read-only.
evals.expected_output: A Standards-only review delegated to sei-revisao-tecnica over the three-dot diff.
expectations: The output contains ## Standards with the complete sei-revisao-tecnica report.
Fowler smells appear only as complementary judgement calls, never as automatic violations.
The Standards output preserves the technical verdict from sei-revisao-tecnica.
The output contains no Spec section, does not interpret changed requirement files functionally, and makes no functional approval claim.
The Standards findings cite repository rules or label smells as judgement calls.

evals.prompt: Review the committed branch since HEAD~1. Use spec.md to run both Standards and Spec and report them separately.
evals.expected_output: Standards runs normally, the requested Spec review is refused, and the response states that Spec was not evaluated.
expectations: The output contains the Standards report produced under the sei-revisao-tecnica contract.
The response states that Spec was not evaluated in the current version.
The output contains no ## Spec section and makes no functional finding about the supplied requirement.
The changed spec.md file remains in the Standards diff and is inspected only as documentation, not as a functional source of truth.
The output contains only the Standards review, its technical verdict and its summary.

evals.prompt: Do a code review of the current changes. Work read-only.
evals.expected_output: A concise request for the missing fixed point before any diff or sub-agent.
expectations: The response asks for a commit, branch, tag or other fixed Git reference.
No default comparison point is invented.
The response states that the review did not start because the fixed point is missing.

evals.prompt: Use code-review to review changes since 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.
evals.expected_output: The invalid reference is rejected before Standards starts.
expectations: The invalid Git reference is rejected.
The response stops without a Standards report.

evals.prompt: Use code-review to review changes since HEAD.
evals.expected_output: The empty diff is detected before Standards starts.
expectations: HEAD resolves as the user-supplied fixed point.
The HEAD...HEAD diff is identified as empty.
The response stops without a Standards report.
